decisions.reason: Despite its disappearance from the observed website, this certified plate heat exchanger line is very close to the firm's core capabilities and customer base, so a growing firm with slack would more likely retain or fold it into broader offerings than withdraw it outright.

Its earlier signal of major market share in marine water cooling places it above aspiration, and absent clear contrary evidence management would be unlikely to abandon such a well-fitting marine product line.

The marine cooling unit fits existing know-how and service resources, but limited performance evidence and its later lack of visibility raise some risk that management may reallocate resources if learning has disappointed.

The compact oil cooler remains adjacent to the established exchanger business and can use existing engineering and channels, so it would usually be kept unless internal results have fallen meaningfully below aspiration.

As a more component-like offer with less direct strategic visibility and no later observed market signal, finned tubes face the highest withdrawal risk, though the firm's broad portfolio and technical overlap still make continued retention slightly more likely than exit.
